reason: An experimental developer-oriented distribution format for organizing versioned component sets and defaults, with a draft schema and deterministic local validation tools; the README explicitly states that no production installer or production component set is included.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于组织版本化组件集和默认配置的实验性开发工具，提供草案格式与本地确定性校验工具。
summaries.en: An experimental developer tool for organizing versioned component sets and defaults through a draft format and deterministic local validation tools.

capabilities: Defines a draft schema for versioned component sets and defaults
Provides local validation and public-boundary checks
Provides release-readiness checks for documented component definitions
